items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Alfred Laine Interview, 1951-04-21
items.q: The interviewee identifies himself as George V Lane ('My full name is George Lane. George V Lane.'). The person to judge is George V Lane. Since the interviewee is the person themselves, there is no interpersonal relationship to judge in the context of 'relationship between the INTERVIEWEE and ONE s

ctx.x: For the 21st, and I'm down at Papa Jack Lane's house at 521 Clouette Street. Mrs. Lane is right alongside of us both, chaperoning this party. And I wanted to ask Jack a few questions, if you'd be kind enough to answer. Jack, what is your full name?

My full name is George Lane. George V Lane. I was born here in the state, never was out of the state in my life. The farthest I've been was New York or Chicago or something of that sort, but never out of the state. And I've been playing music since I was a boy, I reckon about eight years old. And of course... Wait a minute, you didn't tell us the date of your birth, Jack. Well, I was born in 1873 on the 21st day of September. And ever since then, why, I enjoyed music the best of anyone should like it as much as I…
Well, you started telling me that you were about eight years old when you started to play music. What instrument did you fool with then?
